summary.goal: Integrate agent-relay to enable real AI-assisted planning via spawned planning agents that use MCP tools to build plans collaboratively with humans
summary.context: Currently, AI features (chat, improvements) return mock responses. The architecture docs describe spawning planning agents via relay-pty that connect back to Planner's MCP server to actually create/edit plans. This epic bridges that gap using the Hybrid pattern: HTTP APIs for orchestrator integration + Relay for planning agent features.
in_scope: Relay SDK integration and daemon connection
MCP bridge allowing agents to call Planner tools via HTTP
Session management (start, monitor, terminate planning sessions)
Connect UI AI chat to real planning agent conversations
Connect UI silent improvements to agent-driven analysis
Agent handling for change requests from orchestrator

acceptance_criteria.description: Planning agent can be spawned when a plan is created
Agent uses MCP tools (add_step, edit_step, etc.) to modify plan via HTTP transport
Human edits and agent edits both persist to same SQLite database with version conflict handling
UI chat sends messages to planning agent, receives real responses
Silent improvements come from agent analysis via suggest_improvement MCP tool
Planning session terminates when plan is approved or times out
Change requests spawn revision agent to draft plan updates
Graceful fallback to mock mode when relay-daemon unavailable

plan_implementation.approach: Hybrid pattern - HTTP APIs remain for orchestrator, add relay for spawning planning agents

shared_components.name: useAIConnectionStatus hook
shared_components.description: Shared UI hook for checking session status, used by both chat and improvements features

shared_components.name: Planning agent system prompt
shared_components.description: System prompt for planning agents, includes improvement analysis instructions

risks.risk: relay-daemon must be running for planning to work
risks.mitigation: Graceful fallback to mock mode when relay unavailable, automatic reconnection

risks.risk: MCP tool calls from agent could conflict with human edits
risks.mitigation: Optimistic locking via version numbers, agent re-reads plan state on conflict
Session timeouts (default 30 min), terminate on approval, explicit kill capability
Spawn errors logged but don't fail plan creation, UI shows fallback to demo mode
